infrastructureInterruption.reason: Execution session no longer existed and no benchmark/server process remained. Startup log ends at server remapping; no world or bot memory was created.
infrastructureInterruption.retryPolicy: Retain startup attempt, resume same source and settings for seed355620996, then previously unstarted1276821265 and1244186709. No completed gameplay result replaced.

limitations: One startup-only attempt for355620996 stopped before world creation or bot gameplay; retained separately and restarted unchanged. No completed gameplay outcome was replaced.
Same known seeds are regression evidence, not held-out reliability. Mob and item timing varies.
The separate targeted107.416-second replay is not substituted into this cohort.
Passing seeds do not by themselves prove the new clearance helper executed.
Prepared fixtures and command/control scores are separate evidence; no paid planner, real Windows gameplay or actual Bedrock-client run was validated.

source.note: Every outcome is retained. The separate targeted replay is excluded. Identical pass/fail set to the previous release is not a causal effect estimate or held-out reliability.
